02 - Rebuild Gerbera library
info: Resolves each station in config/gerbera/radio-stations.json against Radio Browser, publishes external-URL items into Gerbera via its REST API, then writes node-red/data/presets.json mapping preset id -> UPNP ContentItem.

label: 03 - Sync presets to device
info: Backs up the device's current /presets to disk, then writes the UPNP ContentItems from presets.json into slots 1-6 via /setPresetButton. Restores the physical IR remote.

label: 04 - State polling
info: Every 10s polls /now_playing on every known room and publishes to soundtouch/state/<room>.
